hints: Read the command with scanf(" %c", &c) - the leading space skips the newline left by the previous line. Without it every other command reads '\n'.
The two-children delete: find the smallest key in the right subtree, copy it into the node, then delete that key from the right subtree recursively.
An empty tree prints NULL for p, t and b - check before calling the traversal.
